sentences.text: Es sábado por la noche, y en la casa de doña Marta todos se preparan para el domingo.
sentences.english: It is Saturday night, and in doña Marta's house everyone is getting ready for Sunday.

sentences.text: Nico se acuesta temprano.
sentences.english: Nico goes to bed early.

sentences.text: Doña Marta cepilla los zapatos de él.
sentences.english: Doña Marta brushes his shoes.

sentences.text: Ana y Karla llegan con el pan.
sentences.english: Ana and Karla arrive with the bread.

sentences.text: —Nosotras llevamos el pan y el café al templo —dice Ana.
sentences.english: "We are taking the bread and the coffee to the church," says Ana.

sentences.text: Sam lee el grupo del equipo en su celular.
sentences.english: Sam reads the team group on his phone.

sentences.text: Daniel mandó un correo.
sentences.english: Daniel sent an email.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Mañana nos reunimos en el templo a las ocho y treinta.
sentences.english: Tomorrow we meet at the church at eight thirty.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Hay una familia nueva, y quiero darles una buena bienvenida.
sentences.english: There is a new family, and I want to give them a good welcome.

sentences.text: Sam contesta: —Voy a asistir con Nico.
sentences.english: Sam answers, "I am going to attend with Nico.

sentences.text: Me voy a sentar con él.
sentences.english: I am going to sit with him."

sentences.text: Sam se acuesta tarde, porque estudia el versículo de la semana.
sentences.english: Sam goes to bed late, because he studies the verse of the week.

sentences.text: Es del capítulo tres de Juan.
sentences.english: It is from chapter three of John.

sentences.text: Doña Marta se levanta a las cinco.
sentences.english: Doña Marta gets up at five.

sentences.text: Se baña y se cepilla el pelo.
sentences.english: She bathes and brushes her hair.

sentences.text: Nico se despierta a las siete.
sentences.english: Nico wakes up at seven.

sentences.text: —¡Levantate! —dice su abuela.
sentences.english: "Get up!" says his grandmother.

sentences.text: Los dos salen de la casa.
sentences.english: The two leave the house.

sentences.text: Caminan a la iglesia con Sam, Ana y Karla.
sentences.english: They walk to the church with Sam, Ana and Karla.

sentences.text: La iglesia tiene un techo rojo y paredes blancas.
sentences.english: The church has a red roof and white walls.

sentences.text: La semana pasada llovió mucho.
sentences.english: Last week it rained a lot.

sentences.text: Un rayo cayó cerca de la iglesia, y el techo se rompió.
sentences.english: A bolt of lightning fell near the church, and the roof broke.

sentences.text: Todos tuvimos un susto, pero no hubo peligro.
sentences.english: We all got a fright, but there was no danger.

sentences.text: Luis y Carlos arreglaron el techo el sábado.
sentences.english: Luis and Carlos fixed the roof on Saturday.

sentences.text: Ahora está bien.
sentences.english: Now it is fine.

sentences.text: Antes del culto, en el patio, la gente se saluda.
sentences.english: Before the service, in the patio, people greet each other.

sentences.text: Los hombres se abrazan, y las mujeres se dan un beso.
sentences.english: The men hug, and the women give each other a kiss.

sentences.text: Un abrazo y un beso son la bienvenida de esta gente.
sentences.english: A hug and a kiss are the welcome of these people.

sentences.text: —Buenos días, hermano Sam —dice el señor Mario—.
sentences.english: "Good morning, brother Sam," says don Mario.

sentences.text: Que Dios lo bendiga.
sentences.english: "May God bless you."

sentences.text: El señor Mario abraza a Sam con mucho gusto.
sentences.english: Señor Mario hugs Sam gladly.

sentences.text: Ana y Karla se saludan con un abrazo.
sentences.english: Ana and Karla greet each other with a hug.

sentences.text: Una familia llega a la iglesia.
sentences.english: A family arrives at the church.

sentences.text: El pastor Andrés la saluda: —Les damos la bienvenida.
sentences.english: Pastor Andrés greets them: "We welcome you."

sentences.speaker: R
sentences.text: Gracias, pastor.
sentences.english: Thank you, pastor.

sentences.speaker: R
sentences.text: Yo soy creyente, pero mi familia no.
sentences.english: I am a believer, but my family is not.

sentences.speaker: R
sentences.text: Hoy vienen conmigo.
sentences.english: Today they are coming with me.

sentences.text: Sam presta su Biblia a Roberto.
sentences.english: Sam lends his Bible to Roberto.

sentences.text: Roberto promete devolverla después del culto.
sentences.english: Roberto promises to return it after the service.

sentences.text: La congregación se sienta.
sentences.english: The congregation sits down.

sentences.text: Hay mucha gente en el templo: hombres, mujeres y niños.
sentences.english: There are many people in the church: men, women and children.

sentences.text: Primero hay alabanza.
sentences.english: First there is praise.

sentences.text: La congregación canta, y Sam canta también.
sentences.english: The congregation sings, and Sam sings too.

sentences.text: Después el pastor lee un versículo del capítulo tres.
sentences.english: Then the pastor reads a verse from chapter three.

sentences.text: Todos lo leen.
sentences.english: Everyone reads it.

sentences.text: —Este versículo habla de cómo Dios ama a su gente —dice el pastor.
sentences.english: "This verse speaks of how God loves his people," says the pastor.

sentences.text: Cuando el pastor predica, Nico escucha.
sentences.english: When the pastor preaches, Nico listens.

sentences.text: El pastor habla con palabras fáciles.
sentences.english: The pastor speaks in easy words.

sentences.text: Hoy predica sobre una oveja perdida.
sentences.english: Today he preaches about a lost sheep.

sentences.text: Dice que Dios busca a todos.
sentences.english: He says that God looks for everyone.

sentences.text: Después hay un momento para el diezmo y la ofrenda.
sentences.english: Then there is a moment for the tithe and the offering.

sentences.text: Doña Marta pone su diezmo en la caja.
sentences.english: Doña Marta puts her tithe in the box.

sentences.text: El pastor explica que el diezmo es para agradecer a Dios.
sentences.english: The pastor explains that the tithe is for thanking God.

sentences.text: Cada familia da lo que puede.
sentences.english: Each family gives what it can.

sentences.text: Después hay un testimonio.
sentences.english: Then there is a testimony.

sentences.text: Marvin se levanta y habla a la congregación.
sentences.english: Marvin stands up and speaks to the congregation.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Hace años, una noche de lluvia, perdí mi casa en una inundación.
sentences.english: Years ago, one rainy night, I lost my house in a flood.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Hubo truenos, y un rayo cayó cerca.
sentences.english: There were thunderclaps, and lightning fell nearby.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Después hubo un incendio.
sentences.english: Then there was a fire.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Yo gritaba, y mi familia lloraba.
sentences.english: I was shouting, and my family was crying.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Escapamos a la iglesia.
sentences.english: We escaped to the church.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Los hermanos nos ofrecieron comida y camas.
sentences.english: The brothers offered us food and beds.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Yo no era creyente.
sentences.english: I was not a believer.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Pero la iglesia me enseñó que Dios cuida a su gente.
sentences.english: But the church taught me that God takes care of his people.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Hoy soy creyente, y quiero bautizarme en septiembre.
sentences.english: Today I am a believer, and I want to be baptized in September.

sentences.speaker: M
sentences.text: Gracias a Dios y gracias a ustedes.
sentences.english: Thanks be to God and thanks to you.

sentences.text: El pastor responde: —Gracias, Marvin.
sentences.english: The pastor answers, "Thank you, Marvin.

sentences.text: El bautismo es para los que creen en Dios.
sentences.english: Baptism is for those who believe in God."

sentences.text: Otros dos hermanos también quieren bautizarse.
sentences.english: Two other brothers also want to be baptized.

sentences.text: Hay tres bautismos en septiembre.
sentences.english: There are three baptisms in September.

sentences.text: —Voy a avisar en el grupo —dice el pastor—.
sentences.english: "I will announce it in the group," says the pastor.

sentences.text: Y mando un correo con el horario.
sentences.english: "And I will send an email with the schedule."

sentences.text: Karla comparte una foto de la congregación en el celular.
sentences.english: Karla shares a photo of the congregation on her phone.

sentences.text: Cuando acaba el culto, la gente se despide, pero muchos se quedan en el patio.
sentences.english: When the service ends, people say goodbye, but many stay in the patio.

sentences.text: —Nosotras preparamos el café y el pan —dice Ana.
sentences.english: "We are preparing the coffee and the bread," says Ana.

sentences.text: Roberto habla con Sam.
sentences.english: Roberto talks with Sam.

sentences.speaker: R
sentences.text: Le devuelvo su Biblia.
sentences.english: I am giving you back your Bible.

sentences.speaker: R
sentences.text: Gracias.
sentences.english: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: R
sentences.text: Mi esposa quiere asistir de nuevo.
sentences.english: My wife wants to attend again.

sentences.text: —Prometo asistir todos los domingos —dice la esposa de Roberto.
sentences.english: "I promise to attend every Sunday," says Roberto's wife.

sentences.text: El pastor abraza a Roberto.
sentences.english: The pastor hugs Roberto.

sentences.text: —Quiero dar mi testimonio en septiembre —dice Roberto—.
sentences.english: "I want to give my testimony in September," says Roberto.

sentences.text: Pero primero necesito aprender.
sentences.english: "But first I need to learn."

sentences.text: —Gracias por tu testimonio, Marvin —dice el pastor—.
sentences.english: "Thank you for your testimony, Marvin," says the pastor.

sentences.text: El día del bautismo es una fiesta para todos.
sentences.english: "The day of baptism is a celebration for everyone.

sentences.text: Voy a bautizar a los tres.
sentences.english: I am going to baptize the three of you."

sentences.text: Ana dice: —El pastor cumple cuarenta años en octubre.
sentences.english: Ana says, "The pastor turns forty in October.

sentences.text: Vamos a celebrar.
sentences.english: We are going to celebrate."

sentences.text: Los jóvenes se reúnen los martes, y los hermanos estudian la Biblia el miércoles.
sentences.english: The young people meet on Tuesdays, and the brothers study the Bible on Wednesdays.

sentences.text: —¿Cuándo nos vemos de nuevo? —pregunta Sam.
sentences.english: "When do we see each other again?" asks Sam.

sentences.text: —El jueves nos reunimos con el equipo —responde Ana.
sentences.english: "On Thursday we meet with the team," answers Ana.

sentences.text: Doña Marta está cansada.
sentences.english: Doña Marta is tired.

sentences.text: —Nosotras la acompañamos a la casa —dice Karla.
sentences.english: "We will accompany her to the house," says Karla.

sentences.text: Sam, Ana y Karla la acompañan.
sentences.english: Sam, Ana and Karla accompany her.

sentences.text: Nico va con ellos.
sentences.english: Nico goes with them.

sentences.text: Él también acompaña a su abuela.
sentences.english: He also accompanies his grandmother.

sentences.text: En la casa, Nico se despide de Sam con un abrazo.
sentences.english: At the house, Nico says goodbye to Sam with a hug.

sentences.text: Doña Marta se despide con un beso.
sentences.english: Doña Marta says goodbye with a kiss.

sentences.text: —Que Dios te bendiga, Sam —dice.
sentences.english: "May God bless you, Sam," she says.

sentences.text: Sam camina solo por la calle.
sentences.english: Sam walks alone down the street.

sentences.text: Piensa en la bienvenida de esta gente y está feliz.
sentences.english: He thinks about the welcome of these people and is happy.

sentences.text: El pastor predica muy bien.
sentences.english: The pastor preaches very well.

sentences.text: Esta noche Sam va a leer el capítulo tres de nuevo.
sentences.english: Tonight Sam is going to read chapter three again.
